name: What's the difference between drain snaking and hydro-jetting?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between drain snaking and hydro-jetting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drain snaking involves a flexible auger that is pushed through pipes to break apart or pull out minor to moderate clogs. It's effective for localized blockages like hair or small objects. Hydro-jetting, on the other hand, uses highly pressurized water to scour the entire inner circumference of pipes, removing stubborn grease, scale, and root intrusions. Hydro-jetting provides a more thorough cleaning and is better for severe blockages or preventative maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Snaking uses an auger to break up or remove localized clogs, while hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to thoroughly clean pipes and remove severe blockages like grease or roots.
